wiki.title: Mike Soboleski
wiki.extract: Michael Arthur "Mike" Soboleski (born 1956/1957) is an American politician from the state of Maine. A member of the Republican Party, he has represented the 73rd district in the Maine House of Representatives since 2023. Soboleski ran for the U.S. House in the 2024 election but was defeated by Donald Trump-endorsed Austin Theriault in the Republican primary.
